 <div class="dmRespRow u_1572301386 dmSectionNoParallax" id="1572301386"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1884937389"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 large-6 medium-6 u_1519436950" id="1519436950"> <div class="u_1385139413 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1385139413" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s; text-align: left;"><p class="m-size-26 size-32" style="line-height: normal;"><strong class="font-size-32 m-font-size-26" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Hotel Todo Bien</strong></p><p class="m-size-19 size-24" style="line-height: normal;"><span class="m-font-size-19 font-size-24" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">An Oceanfront Resort</span></p><p style="line-height: normal;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18" style="line-height: initial;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Where cactus forests and the Baja mountains meet the rich blue waters of the Sea of Cortez, Todo Bien is La Ventana&rsquo;s premier beachfront destination.</span></p><p style="line-height: initial;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18" style="line-height: initial;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Here, nature, adventure, and deep relaxation come together. Mornings are glassy and unhurried, opening into sunlit afternoons shaped by wind, water, and movement. Paddle the shoreline on a complimentary board or kayak, kite-board or wing-foil across the bay, cycle through cactus forests, walk the beach, chase blue marlin, spot whales, or simply linger by the pool under an open sky.</span></p><p style="line-height: initial;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18" style="line-height: initial;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">However you move through your day, our caring and attentive team ensures everything flows smoothly, allowing you to fully settle into the rhythm of La Ventana.</span></p><p style="line-height: initial;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18" style="line-height: initial;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">The hotel is thoughtfully designed around understated comfort, convenience, and wellness: a laid-back yet refined bar and restaurant; heated pool and hot tub; fire pit; palapa lounge; yoga deck; and beachfront gear storage. Every space is carefully placed to frame the landscape, encourage connection, and support rest, recovery, and quiet moments between the action.</span></p><p style="line-height: initial;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18" style="line-height: initial;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Todo Bien welcomes wind-chasers, fishermen, mountain bikers, families, barefoot travelers, and all those who play and find peace by the ocean.&nbsp;</span></p><p style="line-height: normal;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p style="line-height: normal;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p style="line-height: normal;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p style="letter-spacing: 0.3px;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div>

 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1868250127" id="1868250127" style="display: block;" data-version="5"><p class="text-align-center"><strong style="font-weight: 600; display: initial; text-transform: uppercase;">Our Secret Place!</strong></p></div> <div class="graphicWidget graphicWidgetV2 graphicWidgetV3 u_1033090194" data-element-type="graphic" data-widget-type="graphic" id="1033090194"> <svg width="100%" height="100%" version="1.1" viewbox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" id="1967051628" class="svg u_1967051628" data-icon-custom="true" data-icon-name="5 stars_6740288.svg"></svg>

 <div class="u_1561713996 dmNewParagraph" id="1561713996" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; display: block; text-align: left;" data-version="5"><p class="text-align-left m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:italic;">We feel lucky to have found Todo Bien while researching our first ever trip to Mexico, we had the most amazing time staying in La Ventana at this magnificent property.</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1763766410" id="1763766410" style="display: block; transition: none; text-align: left;" data-version="5"><p class="text-align-center"><strong style="text-transform: uppercase; display: initial; font-weight: bold;">- Stephane P.</strong></p></div></div>

 </p></div> <div class="graphicWidget graphicWidgetV2 graphicWidgetV3 u_1738738641" data-element-type="graphic" data-widget-type="graphic" id="1738738641"> <svg width="100%" height="100%" version="1.1" viewbox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" id="1580340800" class="svg u_1580340800" data-icon-custom="true" data-icon-name="5 stars_6740288.svg"></svg>

 <div class="u_1279220942 dmNewParagraph" id="1279220942" data-version="5"><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-left"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:italic;">I can&rsquo;t say enough about how spectacular Todo Bien is. The architecture and design is beautiful.</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1260315156" id="1260315156" style="display: block; transition: none; text-align: left;" data-version="5"><p class="text-align-center"><strong style="font-weight: bold; display: initial; text-transform: uppercase;">- Jim B.</strong></p></div></div>

Made with intention, enjoyed slowly. From the care behind every step to that first sip overlooking the sea &mdash; some moments are worth taking your time for. 🤍
